kind: bug / Graph / control flow / mixed bool condition
title: Graph mode fails to compile while conditions combining Python bool and scalar Tensor bool
duplicate_search_queries: site:github.com/mindspore-ai/mindspore/issues MindSpore Graph while "Cannot join the return values" "AbstractTensor" "AbstractScalar" bool
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 Graph mode supports while/if control flow and scalar Tensor bool predicates in adjacent controls.
The Python while condition is a valid boolean expression combining a Python scalar comparison and a scalar Tensor comparison with and.
The mixed if condition passes, pure Python while passes, and pure Tensor while passes; the failure is localized to mixed Python/Tensor bool while conditions.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: Graph mode fails during compile before producing a tensor result.
Not a CPU kernel support issue: the failing path is control-flow analysis; adjacent CPU controls compile and run.
Not caused by Tensor getitem in the loop body: TBWH-003 fails without dynamic getitem, and TBWH-004 fails with only constant getitem.
The same failure reproduces across four independent TBWH runs plus the reverse-order TBMIX-002 confirmation.
